recommendation: Keep this audit. Future substantive changes to CQL library usage, dynamic CQL safety, translator options, or media-type guidance should be made in the Using CQL with FHIR, CRMI, or FHIR Extension Pack artifacts, with core retaining concise links from Clinical Reasoning.
issue_request: FHIR-30570 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR core R5 by CDS. It asked to include guidance and conformance requirements from the clinical guidelines and quality measures IGs on CQL use within libraries, plus a later comment about preferring compiled CQL/ELM and sanitizing inputs for dynamically constructed CQL.
initial_application: Jira comments record that the detailed guidance was consolidated outside base FHIR rather than duplicated in core. HL7/fhir commit 2e2ccec2adf474bbdbb66019700fc8f71ecc3b99 in PR #2635 added a pointer from source/clinicalreasoning-topics-using-expressions.html to external CQL guidance, with companion applications in CRMI and the FHIR Extension Pack.
additional_context: The Using Expressions topic is in active build scope through source/hierarchy.xml. Later Applied issue FHIR-43175 and commits bef4e71b772211a695d045c7aabdd660ddc33588/a6329ef5d1e8951a0bbe48b2ac5b0f54a6468a7e corrected the old CRMI/markdown target to the published Using CQL with FHIR IG. Related combined-branch audits for FHIR-32667 and FHIR-32670 already cover nearby CQL library version and translator-options work as maintained in external CQL/CRMI/Extension Pack artifacts.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No FHIR core source edit is needed because the current build-scoped page already directs implementers to the maintained CQL guidance, and duplicating that detailed guidance in core would create avoidable maintenance drift.
